title: Micromemo: Morning Launch & PRD Quickchecks
body:
Quick morning scratchpad — capture before meetings. Treat as ephemeral; move items to Jira/Confluence if they persist.

Topline intent for today:
- Finalize small PRD edits for embedding endpoint (clarify rate-limit semantics + error examples).
- Check with infra SRE on canary traffic window for dedicated rollout.
- Triage UX copy for streaming cancel behaviour.

Micro-run routine (my 10-min pre-stand):
- 1) Open PRD quick-diff: look for ambiguous HTTP codes (501 vs 503 notes).
- 2) Flag any missing example responses (JSON schema).
- 3) Ping Ethan re: perf benchmark variance (last run 98 p50 vs baseline 85).

PRD edits to make (inline notes):
- Section: "rate limiting" — add concrete example: "client receives 429 with Retry-After header; recommended backoff 500ms-2s jittered".
- Clarify: ephemeral tokens vs long-lived; call out scopes for embeddings-only keys.
- Replace phrase "best-effort" with "soft SLO" where appropriate.
- Add small appendix: "expected error cases + suggested retry behavior" with code snippets (node/python).

Launch checklist snippets (for quick copy into Confluence):
- Code: feature branch merged, smoke tests green (CI: console/smoke-embeds).
- Infra: canary pool ready in us-west2, connection limit tests at 70% capacity.
- Observability: tracing hooks exist for token-level cost, alert threshold set at +15% token spend anomaly.
- Rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 4 hours, auto-rollback on error rate > 1.5% for 15m.
- Docs: SDK examples for JS + Python + cURL; update changelog entry.

Stakeholder follow-ups (who to ping):
- Ethan Park (benchmarks): ask for re-run with batch size 8 and seq len 512; deadline EOD.
- Lina Sørensen (research/model): confirm quantized variant accuracy delta on our eval set.
- SRE on-call (tag: @infra-rot): approve canary window 02:00-06:00 UTC.
- Legal: fast signoff on data retention clause for private customers — link to Contract_Exceptions_Jan2026.

Open questions / risks:
- If KV cache invalidation causes higher tail latency, do we have a fallback to smaller batch sizes automatically? (Check runtime routing policy config).
- What is expected behavior if a user pins a model that becomes incompatible with an upgraded runtime kernel? (Need explicit fallback policy in PRD).
- Cost: estimated token unit change after batching/quantization changes — update cost sheet and flag to finance if >5% delta.

Meeting notes snippets (to paste into stand / follow-ups):
- 09:15 sync w/ infra: discuss canary gating metrics (latency p95, error rate, token cost). Asked infra to add heatmap for seq_len distribution.
- 10:00 UX review: prefer "Cancel" vs "Stop streaming" — decide to keep "Stop streaming" for clarity in logs. Lina will update copy by Thursday.

Action items (short):
- [ ] Edit PRD: add example Retry-After + code snippets (Priya) — target: today 5pm.
- [ ] Create Jira ticket for SDK examples missing curl snippets (RDW-4938).
- [ ] Slack ping @ethan: bench re-run params.
- [ ] Email legal: quick question about retention wording (copy pasted clause).
- [ ] Drop a note in #product-launches: canary window + rollback plan.

Notes to self (brain dump):
- Keep this micro-memo to <1 page; move persistent todo to Jira by EOD.
- If blocked on legal, proceed with soft rollout to internal-only orgs for validation.
- Remember to capture a short blurb for the weekly launch email (3 bullets: what, why, how rollback works).

Random scratch / half-formed ideas:
- Micro-telemetry: expose a small metric for "prompt-trim rate" (how often we auto-truncate prompts) — could drive UX copy + pricing signal.
- Consider a "preview" option in Console for embeddings results with limited example set to reduce noise when testing.

End of micromemo.

Older refs / quick links: copy these into linked artifacts when cleaning up:
- CONFLUENCE: /pages/viewpage.action?pageId=123456789 (PRD embedding v2 draft)
- JIRA: RDW-4821 (embedding throughput investigation)
- GH PR: console/pull/412 (streaming cancel UX)
